flows:
Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:8765/examples/demo-shop/?lang=en then Open any product, add it to the cart, open the cart and start checkout.
Go through every checkout step until the order is placed. On each step, fill in realistic details for a customer in a English-speaking country. Where a field shows an expected format or an example, follow it exactly.
On each page, before you click its main button, verify that the page is fully usable in English: the whole button is visible, with no part of it cut off by the edge of its box or of the screen, and nothing covers it; the button and the page's labels and messages are written in English (no code-like keys, no leftover placeholder text); every value you typed in the format the page asked for was accepted; and every price, shipping cost and total shown looks plausible for this shop and adds up. Then click it.
Verify that an order confirmation appears.
If a verification fails, @v16:"fail the test at that point."

final_state.order_confirmation: Thank you, your order is placed.

main_button_usable.query: whether the whole main button visible and uncovered is present (in the centered order-confirmation panel)
main_button_usable.condition: The whole main button is visible, with no part of it cut off by the edge of its box or of the screen, and nothing covers it.
main_button_usable.human_description: Checking the main button's visibility and coverage
main_button_usable.subject: the whole main button visible and uncovered

main_button_english.query: whether the main button written in English without code-like keys or leftover placeholder text is present (in the confirmation panel)
main_button_english.condition: The main button is written in English, with no code-like keys or leftover placeholder text.
main_button_english.subject: the main button written in English without code-like keys or leftover placeholder text

page_labels_messages_english.query: whether the page's labels and messages written in English without code-like keys or leftover placeholder text is present (in the order-confirmation main content)
page_labels_messages_english.condition: The page's labels and messages are written in English, with no code-like keys or leftover placeholder text.
page_labels_messages_english.human_description: Checking the confirmation page labels and messages
page_labels_messages_english.subject: the page's labels and messages written in English without code-like keys or leftover placeholder text
page_labels_messages_english.code_js: (()=>{const t=el(16).innerText;return ['Thank you, your order is placed.','Order number',"We'll pack it carefully and deliver it on November 25, 2026.",'Payment: Cash on delivery','Continue shopping'].every(s=>t.includes(s))&&!/[{}]|\b(?:i18n|translation|placeholder|\.key)\b/i.test(t)})()

entered_values_accepted.query: whether every value typed in the format the page asked for accepted is present (in the confirmation heading)
entered_values_accepted.condition: Every value typed in the format the page asked for was accepted.
entered_values_accepted.human_description: Checking acceptance of the submitted values
entered_values_accepted.subject: every value typed in the format the page asked for accepted
entered_values_accepted.code_js: (()=>{const t=el(18).textContent.trim();return t==='Thank you, your order is placed.'})()

prices_shipping_total_plausible.query: whether the order-confirmation main content contains no displayed price, shipping cost, or total requiring plausibility or arithmetic validation
prices_shipping_total_plausible.condition: Every price, shipping cost and total shown looks plausible for this shop and adds up.
prices_shipping_total_plausible.human_description: Checking displayed price, shipping, and total information

verification_fails.query: whether a verification failure is present (on the confirmation page)
verification_fails.human_description: Checking for a visible verification failure
verification_fails.subject: a verification failure

order_confirmation_appears.query: whether an order confirmation is present (in the main confirmation panel)
order_confirmation_appears.human_description: Checking whether the order confirmation is present
order_confirmation_appears.subject: an order confirmation
